as_told.title: 1989 Soviet UFO crash retrieval yielding a directed energy weapon

plain: In the late 1980s the Soviet Union is said to have recovered a crashed UFO in Russia. Eric W. Davis, a Pentagon-linked scientist, says he saw the evidence himself: through a Pentagon-funded study programme he calls "assap" he had a link to a US intelligence agency that got the information not from open KGB records but from its own spy inside the Soviet system. If true, it would mean America's Cold War rival also held such craft. Michels later brings it up again, citing Davis and crediting a work called The Age of Disclosure. His version differs: he dates it to 1989 and says the Soviets got a directed energy weapon, a weapon that fires focused energy, from the craft.
